copy.headline: ‘GTA VI’ Just Might Turn Carly Rae Jepsen Into A “Late in Life Gamer”
copy.caption: The singer's 2015 pop song "Run Away With Me" is experiencing a second life thanks to its inclusion in one of the game's scenes: "I have no idea if this is just a quick moment, but I'm really enjoying it."
